verdict.tagline: Classic multiplayer action remains legendary despite slow updates.
for_you_if: you want a team shooter with deep class mechanics
you can run the game on older hardware
not_for_you_if: you expect original developer-led content updates
you mind paying to unlock communication features

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: New players enter a timeless shooter environment immediately.

cohorts.label: 2-20h
cohorts.summary: Early players appreciate the available training tools and shooting ranges.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game includes offline modes, shooting ranges, and training maps for new players to practice.

citations.review_text: Team Fortress 2 i such a fun game, there is a lot of game modes and maps so you don't get bored. There is also training maps so that you can sharpen your skills. My favorite part is the cosmetics and the taunts, i only have the kazotsky kick but its still fun to use. 11/10
very fun unless very new i suggest playing in the shooting range or offline play until youre ready, or if you dont care then good luck

For an 18 year old game with a supposed high skill sealing, its pretty welcome to new player such as my self who's only been play for a week and has already gotten a handful of achievement and reached level 4, with a tutorial that allows you to get a feel for a chunk of the classes along with an offline mode against A.I that allows for trying out not touched on classes and for just a better understanding of how to play. just would like to add that, I've only played casual since I'm still getting use to the movement of this, but in terms of causal progression I really like how after a few matches you unlock new weapons to play around with not to mention when you boot up the game you may get a bonus cosmetic or spry paint crate. In general I'm pretty happy with my time in this game and I shouldn't have left it sitting in my back logs for as long as I did and I'm thankful to the community that supported this game long enough for me to finally try it, since I just got my PC last year.

citations.review_text: great game just laggy for low ends and you need to lower all your settings lol but great game 10/10 played it since like 2020 on my main account

Literally the best hero shooter game you can play (plus it's free)

Not only is it free but you can get pretty much every item just by playing and the only thing you need to pay for is cosmetics.

Way better than Overwatch 1-2 

Also way better than Marvel Rivals when you take into consideration that 99% of the Marvel Rivals cosmetics is either women showing 90% of their skin or a shirtless dude. Meaning that every match you go into will most likely have half your team wearing some weird a** immersion breaking skimpy clothing.

This game has infinite replayability and every match will be played different. 

Not only that but people playing on older hardware can play with good FPS since the game was made 18 years ago (which is probably why it's still one of the most popular multiplayer games on Steam)

This is definitively the best free game ever. It runs perfectly well on my horrible laptop and computer, so there's no worry about it not being playable. Other than that, it has one of the most well rounded communities i've ever seen. Everyone* is super friendly and all of the creators are super amazing and have created some wonderful items for the game. Speaking of creators, the game itself has such a deep involvement with its fanbase that almost every game i play is on a fanmade map! It has open creative platforms for everyone and has the potential for even young creators to thrive in its market! I love this game for just how diverse it is, but the gameplay is also what keeps me in it! I may be bad at FPS games, and i don't usually play them... but this one offers a completely new dynamic i haven't seen anywhere else! if you can't see yourself creating, you can play. if you can't see yourself playing, them all of the stuff online people have created for the game is also wonderful.
I seriously cannot recommend this game enough. It's genuinely a 10/10. Please play it.

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term players note a heavy reliance on community creations and microtransaction walls.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that new or seasonal content consists primarily of community-created maps, cosmetics, and workshop submissions rather than original development by Valve.

citations.review_text:
I'm autistic, and this game has been a huge hyperfixation of mine for about 2 years now. I can say with full confidence it's the most influential first person shooter game ever. It created a lot of new things for the gaming community, and raised a huge, supporting fandom while it was in it's prime. 

On the other hand, I can't even begin to describe how depressed it makes me to know that TF2 will likely die out in a couple years time due to it's incredibly rare updates. When there are updates; they are incredibly small and low effort, especially when all they do is input pieces that were made by the hardworking workshop community into the game.. For example, there has never been a big Heavy update, but if there were to be, I believe it would draw both previous and new players to the game. Besides, TF2 doesn't have many current developers, so there's no doubt why it's been so slow. :(
Please, please, please; if you care about this game, try your best to spread positivity and continue to support it. 
They listened to us about the bots, they might listen to us about this.

I recommend this game immensely.  It's given me lots of good experience and internet gaming etiquette. There are both ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ and sweethearts on here, and I've grown from both.  

Also, TF2's birthday is Oct 10, which is also mine :3 !!!

A once great game ruined by a neglectful corporation who only cares about their own bottom line and reputation, 10 years of meet your match and nothing to show for it don't waste your time on this game like I did. Valve has made it clear they don't care about even doing the bare minimum they just shovel more hats, maps, skins and taunts they didn't even make into the game without care or consideration, the fact that it took SIX YEARS of a grass roots movement to deal with the bot cheaters should tell you that they only do things when the main stream gaming journalists (who Valve bribes with lavish dinners btw) catch wind when the problem gets so bad that it can no longer be ignored and them just doing not even the bare minium.

There is ZERO reason to invest your time or money into this game, even if you got another hashtag going it's not going to change anything unless a big youtuber with some actual clout caught wind and rightfully calls them out, match making has been broken since DAY 1 and for what? a failed competitive mode nobody ever plays? is it even worth keeping at this point? no it isn't yet they can't just admit that it's bad and revert it because god forbid if Valve isn't seen as the paragon of gaming companies.

Fact is, this game makes MILLIONS of dollars every day alone yet leaves it in a buggy broken state is enough to tell any new player not to stick around.

Every update is just a few maps and cosmetics created by the community, and nothing of substance. And even when they're doing the bare minimum, everything comes out broken and designed so poorly it makes kusoges look good in comparison. It's not unfun but it's disgusting to see this game has turned into just a microtransaction and gambling factory with no love from Valve.

I don't hate TF2, I want it to be better.
The game doesn't get proper updates. All new content is made by the community meaning Valve doesn't put any effort into one of their most well known games but still make money in spite of that.
The new maps bloat the game, increasing the file size only to be nearly abandoned two weeks after release.
Quickplay was better.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features in-game purchases and item microtransactions such as cosmetics, taunts, crates, keys, and weapons.

citations.review_text: Repetitive and gets annoying. Stopped being funny after a while. Do not play alone nor on casual nor waste money on weapons, taunts (most community servers have a !taunt command), crates (I used a key once and it felt like losing $5 at a casino) and cosmetics (don't try to be funny, you're not!). If you see quickscopers, even in servers you do not expect them to be in, understand they may have lost a Premier CS2 match and taking out their anger. To "get good" you'd need to waste a lot of time. Script kiddies are rampant too unfortunately I am not trained to spot them to notice. Based on further research, its said that this is a corpse of what it once was so I don't think I am actually getting the intended experience. This is what I would tell my 6 months ago self.

Every update is just a few maps and cosmetics created by the community, and nothing of substance. And even when they're doing the bare minimum, everything comes out broken and designed so poorly it makes kusoges look good in comparison. It's not unfun but it's disgusting to see this game has turned into just a microtransaction and gambling factory with no love from Valve.
